title: arabis alpina subsp. lerchenfeldiana
intro: Arabis alpina subsp. lerchenfeldiana, commonly known as Rock Cress or Alpine Rock Cress, is a plant species in the mustard family (Brassicaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Arabis alpina subsp. lerchenfeldiana include sedative and anxiolytic effects, which can aid in the treatment of anxiety disorders and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
